title: 第3章 红色瞳孔第4章 天神山
content_zh:
听到周围的尖叫声，林刚猛地回过神来，马上抬头，发现所有人都在惊恐看着自己！
不远处，那些侍卫听到尖叫声后也一下子看了过来，林刚心里一慌，毫不犹豫往前跑，一跳直接骑上马！
“阿茹，小六，快上来！”林刚看着自己的妻儿，大声喊道！
杨茹已经有些被吓傻了，仿佛没有听到丈夫的大喊一样呆立在原地。小六见状皱紧眉头，一把抓着娘亲的手飞快朝着马跑去！
两人来到马前，林刚一把将妻儿都拽上马后，用力用双腿踢马肚子，大声喊道，“驾！！”
只听那马一声嘶吼，前蹄高高举起，跟着飞快跑了起来！
“来人！快抓住他，别让他跑了！”那胖子一身肥肉在轿子中手舞足蹈，大声喊道！
此时，所有侍卫都已经骑上马，飞快朝着逃亡的林刚跑去！
林刚也在策马奔驰，他看着后面追来的侍卫，深知杀了人的奴隶一定是死罪！不仅如此，就连妻儿也会受到牵连，所以无论如何，他也不能被这些人抓到！
“驾！”又是一声大喊，林刚尽全力驱使身下的马，而马似乎也被刺激了一样，速度竟然比平常快上许多！
“阿刚……”杨茹在身后紧紧抱着林刚，害怕得一直在颤抖。
林刚感受到妻子的恐惧，咬牙说道，“放心吧，我一定把你和孩子带出去，不会有事的！”
“对了！孩子！”杨茹听到后一怔，连忙回头看去，发现小六就在身后，正张大嘴巴一脸笑容看着她。
“娘，我没事。”小六嘿嘿一笑，说道，“娘，你也别担心了，离开那个鬼地方应该开心才对！”
说着，小六又探出头对林刚说道，“爹，我今天和他们打架是因为他们又想欺负小蛮，你也知道小蛮长得漂亮，那些人总想占她便宜，所以我才出手打了他们。”
正在驾马的林刚听到后难得露出一点笑容，说道，“教训得好！”
言毕，林刚的脸色再次阴沉下来，飞快赶路。
作为整个子夜国的主要奴隶区，塔不卡尔地区很大很大。林刚驾马狂奔，身后的人也不停追赶，一前一后早已跑出奴隶窟。到处是一望无际的荒野，一切都是光秃秃的，没有植被，一望无际。林刚的马始终暴露后面追赶之人的视野中，连一点能躲的地方都没有。
而就在这个时候，往后看了一眼的林刚突然瞪大眼睛，眼睛中突然出现猩红的血丝！
小六见到父亲的样子很奇怪，也回头看去，却也是一愣！

在他明亮的眼睛里，只见一头白狼出现在身后追赶之人的中间！但这头白狼却是奇怪的大，足足有一头牛那么大！白狼浑身的毛发雪亮，脸上的毛发绷紧如同钢刺一般。白狼一路狂奔，口水从嘴中向外倒流。眼睛发着惨白的光芒，让人不寒而栗。而就在这头白狼的背上，赫然坐着一个身穿蓝袍的中年人！
“爹……那是什么？”小六看着白狼凶狠的样子，忍不住打了个寒颤，有些颤抖问道。
“雪狼。”林刚听到儿子的问话，咬牙说道，“是一种奇兽。”
“奇兽？”这是小六第一次听到这个词，不禁有些好奇问道，“也是用来骑的么？”
林刚摇了摇头，眼神中闪过一丝沉重。他经常在一个码头做苦工奴隶，也多多少少知道一些事情，说道，“奇兽和普通的野兽不一样，是具有智慧和力量的强大生物。最低级的奇兽也要比最强壮的普通人厉害很多，我听说强大奇兽能够翻江倒海，甚至被我们人类奉为图腾。”
小六闻言一知半解，回头再看向那头白狼，忍不住问道，“那奇兽这么厉害，骑在他上面的人岂不是更厉害？”
听到小六的话，林刚的脸色更加阴沉。
没错，这个人很可能就是一位强大的天师！
在这个世界中，人也分为两种，一种是普通人，一种是强大的天师。
天师又分九级，前五级只用数字表示境界，从六级天师开始发生质变，会开始拥有不一样的称号！而远处骑在白狼上的人，很可能就是一级天师！
不要小看一级天师，任何一名天师都绝对不是普通人能相提并论的。天师拥有强大的力量，甚至可以学习法术，做出普通人难以想象的事情。本来林刚还对逃亡抱有一线希望，但见到竟然有一位天师追赶自己，心里一下子就凉了！
然而，林刚不是束手就擒的人，更何况还有自己的妻儿，他只能硬着头皮疯狂驾马，朝着前方跑去！
前方，有一条江叫做坟江，是一条不小的江流。之所以叫坟江，是因为周围奴隶窟里饿死或者病死的人都会被扔到这条江里去。只要三人能跳入江中，随着江水漂流下去，说不定还有一线生机！
啪哒啪哒！
马仿佛也感受到身后雪狼的威胁，马蹄飞快在枯地上奔跑。身后的雪狼也在疯狂追赶，雪狼本来就以速度见长，一匹普通的马如何能跑得过它？
content_en:
Hearing the screams around him, Lin Gang suddenly came back to his senses. He immediately looked up and found that everyone was looking at him in horror!
Not far away, the guards suddenly looked over after hearing the screams. Lin Gang panicked and ran forward without hesitation, jumping directly onto the horse!
"Aru, Xiaoliu, come up quickly!" Lin Gang looked at his wife and children and shouted loudly!
Yang Ru was already a little frightened and stood there as if she hadn't heard her husband's shout. Xiao Liu frowned when he saw this, grabbed his mother's hand and ran towards the horse quickly!
The two came to the horse. Lin Gang pulled his wife and children onto the horse, kicked the horse's belly with both legs, and shouted, "Drive!!"
I heard the horse roar, raised its front hooves high, and started running quickly!
"Come here! Catch him quickly, don't let him run away!" The fat man danced in the sedan chair and shouted loudly!
At this time, all the guards had already mounted their horses and ran quickly towards the fleeing Lin Gang!
Lin Gang was also galloping. He looked at the guards chasing after him and knew that a slave who killed someone must be punished by death! Not only that, even his wife and children will be implicated, so no matter what, he cannot be caught by these people!
"Drive!" shouted again, Lin Gang tried his best to drive the horse under him, and the horse seemed to be stimulated, and the speed was much faster than usual!
"A Gang..." Yang Ru hugged Lin Gang tightly behind her, trembling with fear.
Lin Gang felt his wife's fear, gritted his teeth and said, "Don't worry, I will take you and the child out, nothing will happen to you!"
"That's right! Child!" Yang Ru was startled after hearing this. She quickly looked back and found Xiaoliu behind her, looking at her with a big smile on her face.
"Mom, I'm fine." Xiao Liu chuckled and said, "Mom, don't worry, you should be happy to leave that hellish place!"
With that said, Xiao Liu stuck his head out and said to Lin Gang, "Dad, I fought with them today because they wanted to bully Xiao Man again. You also know that Xiao Man is beautiful, and those people always want to take advantage of her, so I beat them."
Lin Gang, who was driving his horse, showed a rare smile after hearing this and said, "Good lesson!"
After saying that, Lin Gang's face darkened again and he hurried on.
As the main slave area of ​​the entire Midnight Kingdom, the Tabukal area is very large. Lin Gang galloped on his horse, and the people behind him kept chasing. One after another, they had already run out of the slave cave. There is endless wilderness everywhere, everything is bare, without vegetation, as far as the eye can see. Lin Gang's horse was always exposed to the view of those chasing behind him, and there was no place to hide.
At this moment, Lin Gang, who glanced back, suddenly widened his eyes, and scarlet bloodshot eyes suddenly appeared!
Xiaoliu looked very strange when he saw his father. He looked back, but he was also stunned!
In his bright eyes, he saw a white wolf appearing among the people chasing behind him! But this white wolf is strangely big, as big as a cow! The hair on the white wolf's body was shiny, and the hair on his face was as tight as steel thorns. The white wolf ran wildly, saliva flowing backwards from his mouth. The eyes glowed palely, making people shudder. And right on the back of this white wolf, sitting impressively was a middle-aged man in a blue robe!
"Dad...what is that?" Xiao Liu asked, looking at Bai Lang's fierce look, and couldn't help but shudder.
"Snow wolf." Lin Gang heard his son's question and gritted his teeth and said, "It's a strange beast."
"Fantastic beast?" This was the first time Xiao Liu heard this word, and he couldn't help but asked curiously, "Is it also for riding?"
Lin Gang shook his head, a trace of heaviness flashed in his eyes. He often works as a slave at a dock and knows something about it. He said, "Fantastic beasts are different from ordinary beasts. They are powerful creatures with intelligence and strength. The lowest level of strange beasts."They are also much more powerful than the strongest ordinary people. I heard that powerful strange beasts can overwhelm rivers and seas, and are even regarded as totems by us humans. "
Hearing this, Xiao Liu half-understood, turned back to look at the white wolf, and couldn't help but ask, "That strange beast is so powerful, wouldn't the person riding on it be even more powerful? "
After hearing Xiao Liu's words, Lin Gang's expression became even more gloomy.
Yes, this person is probably a powerful heavenly master!
In this world, people are also divided into two types, one is ordinary people, and the other is powerful heavenly masters.
Celestial Masters are divided into nine levels. The first five levels only use numbers to represent the realm. From the sixth level, Celestial Masters will undergo qualitative changes and will begin to have different titles! And the person riding on the white wolf in the distance is probably a first-level heavenly master!
Don't underestimate a first-level Celestial Master. Any Celestial Master is definitely not comparable to ordinary people. The Celestial Master has great power and can even learn spells and do things that are unimaginable for ordinary people. Originally, Lin Gang still had a glimmer of hope for escaping, but when he saw a heavenly master chasing him, his heart suddenly became cold!
However, Lin Gang was not someone who could be easily captured, let alone his wife and children. He could only bite the bullet and drive his horse crazily, running towards the front!
Ahead, there is a river called Fenjiang, which is a large river. The reason why it is called Fenjiang is because people who died of starvation or illness in the surrounding slave caves were thrown into this river. As long as the three of them can jump into the river and float down the river, there might be a glimmer of hope!
Click, click, click!
The horse seemed to feel the threat of the snow wolf behind him, and its hooves ran quickly on the dry ground. The snow wolf behind him was also chasing after him crazily. The snow wolf was known for its speed. How could an ordinary horse outrun it?
